headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Big spending, rushed preps: Nashik Kumbh aims to outmatch Prayagraj’s.
Telangana pitches tourism investment opportunities to US investors.
Amid objections from Opposition LDF and G. Sudhakaran, Keralam Assembly passes SARAL Bill.
Palestinian President says hopes for peace talks with new Israeli government.
bullets_ur: Bhaari akhrajaat aur jaldbazi ki tayyariyan: Nashik Kumbh ka maqsad Prayagraj se aage nikalna hai
Telangana ne US sarmayakaron ko sayahat mein sarmayakari ke mawaqay pesh kiye.
Opposing LDF aur G. Sudhakaran ke aitrazat ke bawujud, Keralam Assembly ne SARAL Bill pass kar diya.
Palestinian President ka kehna hai ke unhein new Israeli government ke sath peace talks ki umeed hai.
